steps.name: Dawn Destroyer
steps.text: I'm curious now. Where did you run off to in the time it took me to use the toilet?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Would you believe me if I told you my life was at risk?

steps.name: Dawn Destroyer
steps.text: I was under the impression that Lungmen was a city of law and order.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm just as curious as you are as to why random pedestrians would be after my head in such a well-policed city.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Okay, I might actually have a pretty good idea of why.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Go find a milk tea place, and get me a cup. See ya.

steps.name: Dawn Destroyer
steps.text: Hey, what the hell's up with your––

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Texas, you could say we're coworkers, right?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: More or less.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I don't think coworkers are supposed to draw swords on each other.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But Exusiai's been looking for you this whole time.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And you're a slippery one, so I figured it'd be easier to hogtie you and haul you over to her.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh, Siracusans. You always get the job done clean.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I have to admit, though, I was this close to letting you do it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But at this point, you can't catch me anymore.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Emperor talked to me about you. I never planned to take you on alone.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, Texas, aren't you on delivery? Why do you need me all of a...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hi there.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mostima?!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Just happened to bump into her.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Good going, Texas!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Same plan as always. I'm up front, you wrap around.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Tie her to a chair. I've got all sorts of ways to make her spill what you're looking for.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Siracusan ways?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Texas ways.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: El, you're not really going to fight me, are you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The boss talks a lot about business culture. Even though his slogans change every day, I've always held onto one for myself––

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Play hard!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So let's play, Mostima.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Alright, we'll play a little game of cops and robbers. If you can catch me, you win.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Does it matter how I do it?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You can even smack me around, El. Use your gun if you'd like.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Don't worry, the commandments don't protect fallen angels.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ooh...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wait, I can't use guns downtown! And you don't get to use your Arts!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Okay, let's dial up the difficulty a bit. You––

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I won't use my Arts.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But you're still going to use your swords, right?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: As long as you don't resist too much, you probably won't get hurt.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Alrighty. Three–– (Winks)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: (Nods slightly)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Start!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: She's fast!

steps.name: Distant Mostima
steps.text: I know all your little tricks, El.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course you do...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Texas, have you eaten?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes. How about you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'll manage.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Then let’s get going.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Alrighty!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya seem mighty busy today, Exusiai.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Eh, I'm okay, Croissant. You're setting a stall up over here?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sure am. Didn't have much work today, so I figured I'd do a little hawkin'.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh right, have you seen a blue-haired angel? I think I saw her linger here for a little while, from off in the distance.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: If'n you mean that Mostima of yers, she went that-a-way.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Alrighty, thanks a bunch.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That about satisfy ya?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And here I was thinking you'd double-cross me halfway through.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Y'all playin' some kinda game?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How'd you know?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Well, I reckon since you've been duckin' her this long, if'n you didn't want her to find you, Exusiai'd never see heads or tails of ya.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Then why didn't you help her?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Let's just say you've piqued my curiosity.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: 'Course, since I helped ya, ya gotta show my enterprise here a li'l love.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Then, I'll have a smoked sausage.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Now yer talkin'.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What do you want to get out of me?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hmm... It's less gettin' somethin' outta ya, and more somethin' I wanted to tell ya.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Since she came here lookin' for ya, n' all the time she spent waitin' for ya, Exusiai's been in Lungmen for a good number of years now.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But I'n see that her search ain't no grave matter o' life n' death. Just look at what a whallopin' good time she's havin' in Lungmen!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: She talks you up as some kinda unbelievably powerful being, carryin' a buncha secrets you can't tell nobody, haulin' a big pile of yer own problems on them shoulders fer good measure.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But it's been an awful long time. Ya do kinda owe her an explanation.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Croissant, grab her.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hey, I got a stall to run here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Fine. Good luck.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Game on, Texas.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: The sausage is my treat then. When yer done with this li'l game, do remember to talk things out with her.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'll think about it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It actually started to rain.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Not a bad thing for someone trying to stay hidden.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh? A venue change?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No way...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But it's raining over here. I can't make it over right now!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Find a way to make it happen?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hey, aren't you being a bit too unreasonable here––

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What a jerk! Treating me like this just because I'm an up-and-comer...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Even if I hailed a cab, I wouldn't make it in time, and it's probably too late to call Texas... What should I do? Do I really have to throw in the towel?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You're Sora, right?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, um, yes, yes I am....

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wait a sec, a blue-haired Sankta with horns... Are you Mostima, the one Exusiai's always looking for?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I have to tell her...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Aren't you kind of busy?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, I guess so.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'm here to help.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll go to her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Then please, I'm counting on you! The address is––

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You can tell me on the way. Hold onto my hand.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, so you want to take the rooftops!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Here is good.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I can't believe I'm here ten minutes early.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Thank you so much, Mostima... Um, ma'am.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: No need for the ma'am now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But, why did you suddenly show up to help me?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Haven't you been hiding from Exusiai this whole time?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Wait, if you want to say something, you should be saying it to her, not me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh say, this whole time, there's been something I've wanted to ask you. Do you mind?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: If it's a question I can answer, fire away.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I want to know, are the Sankta... all as carefree as Exusiai?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I guess, yeah, basically, most are.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hmm... Okay.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I work as an idol. This might sound strange, but one of the most important parts of being an idol is figuring out how to read people's hearts.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I've always believed that if you can open your heart to anyone, then you probably have more than one door into your heart.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The people who seem nice to everyone must be hiding something deep inside.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But I don't think that's true for Exusiai.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Did you know, when Exusiai first joined Penguin Logistics, she was the absolute queen of troublemakers.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She would believe pretty much anything anyone told her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I still remember that day, the day after she joined. The boss asked her to make a delivery so he could test her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas had some things to do, so I ended up being her contact.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: At first, I thought nothing would happen, but turns out...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Basically, you got scammed!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh? Is that what happened?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Of course! In this line of business, it's pretty common for goods to not match up with the sheet on the clipboard, but for there to only be one thing is virtually unheard of.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: There must've been a mix-up.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, I see.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm pretty sure what's going on here is they're spotting a newbie as a mark to take the fall and pushing the blame for the inevitable conflict onto Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You're pretty smart, huh, Sora?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas taught me that too...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No, no, now's not the time! We need to come up with something!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Is there a way out of this?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The simplest way is to find the gang leader who set you up and have him publicly come out to resolve the situation, but that would basically mean facing down the entire gang, so it's not like it's simple.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Then let's give it a try.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I just said, it's not that simple!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, when did you...?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I heard a whisper on the wind, so I rushed over.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes, but we're in kind of a pickle...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You said you'd give it a try, but do you think you have a shot?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: No clue, but since I'm the one who messed up, I'll do what I can to set things right.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So what was supposed to be a simple delivery task turned into the two of them rushing headlong into the territory of a small gang, grabbing their leader, and resolving the incident.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: From that day on, Texas usually took Exusiai with her for all sorts of assignments.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas taught Exusiai a lot of the rules and laws of the biz, the do's and don'ts, so on and so forth.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And now, as you can see, they're good partners.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Does it feel like she snatched away your dear friend?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Maybe a little. But it's more like I'm filled with a sense of awe.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I just couldn't stop thinking to myself... Oh my gosh, how can a person like that be real?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: This might sound funny, but I actually ended up spending a lot of time trying to figure out what she was hiding and expose her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But the longer I searched, the clearer it became that Exusiai really is the same person on the inside that she is on the outside.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm not sure when it happened, but she became my friend too.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: After talking to you today, I think the last little knot in my heart has been undone.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, I need to hurry up and see the manager. If you have time later, I'll take you out for cake!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Sounds good.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How about you? Have you ever suspected her?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm not the type to guess at people like that.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Whatever side people show me, I'll believe in it until they betray me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That makes you pretty similar to El.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What are we gossiping about?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: About whether or not you're a happy-go-lucky fool.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What's there to talk about? Do you think I'm not?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Look.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Haha, that's how she's always been, from the very beginning.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hold on a sec!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I just realized we're right by the place I'm supposed to make a delivery to.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I almost forgot I was in the middle of a delivery when Texas called me over. I'll go take care of that real quick!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So, let's take a halftime break! Wait for me!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So, you're not gonna come at me?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No, because you're taking your game with her seriously.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The bar over there looks pretty decent. How about it?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I've been thinking this whole time that you'd get along pretty well with a grumpy friend of mine.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: And I've realized after meeting you, that you really are the type of person she'd aspire to be.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The what?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: She's never said it before, but I know.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The feeling of pinning the past onto someone, or clinging to something in the past... For some unpleasant reason, I understand that all too well.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But you...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: For the person she is now, you represent the past she was chasing after, one that will only disrupt her present life.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So you really were planning to kill me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sort of. I hope you die quietly in some ditch she doesn't know about.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Or become an afterimage that she can never catch up to.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: El's made some real good friends.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey guys!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I have good news and bad news. Which do you wanna hear first?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The good news.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Another delivery has been completed!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I assume the bad news is you pissed off the recipient?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You got it!

steps.name: Hoodlum
steps.text: Stupid Sankta, you're dead!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I wasn't done talking.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I changed my mind.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: If you were here just to play the good mentor, bending over to listen to the woes of your disciple because you happened to be in a good mood, I'd make you regret it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But that doesn't seem to be the case.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I can tell you on that one, that's definitely not why I'm here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uhh, did I happen to walk in on a heavy conversation or something?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Should I go deal with them myself?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Nah, talk's over. I need some exercise anyway.

steps.name: Hoodlum A
steps.text: Gah, they're too strong.

steps.name: Hoodlum B
steps.text: L-Let's get outta here!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh... I'm getting a bit tired.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Want some chocolate?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sure do. Mostima, want some...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh? Where'd Mostima go?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Looks like she slipped away during the scuffle.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Aw, she Mostima'd...?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There's a letter here. Looks like it's for you.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: For me? Huh, don't tell me she...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: No, hold on, it's from my sister!

a.text: El, I hope you are doing well.
I haven't written in a while. How are you?
Mostima should be handing this to you personally. If she has failed to do that, do be sure to tell me, and I will handle her appropriately.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, turns out Mostima came here to deliver this.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But I guess this counts as her having handed it to me, right?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Read the damned thing first.

a.text: For the longest time, I've been thinking about how to tell you what happened, as your big sister.
Not just because it has to do with Lateran secrets, but more so because neither Mostima nor I feel about this event the way others do.
We're not upset by it, but if we have no way to tell you, then how are we to quell your anger and anxiety?
In the end, I chose to hide in Laterano and avoid you, and Mostima also chose to keep an appropriate distance from you.
All we can do is hope that you find new meaning in your life on the outside.
Don't blame Mostima. If anything, blame your cowardly sister who has been hiding this whole time.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: How could I ever blame you...?

a.text: I once wished that this secret would never come to light. I wished that person would never reappear.
But now I've come to understand that was nothing but an unrealistic delusion.
I've already decided to join the Lateran Curia, and the reason I'm telling you this is––
If you still find yourself interested in the bygone past between me and Mostima, you might get an opportunity to explore it by helping me with my work.
Just to be forthcoming, even if you agree, it may take a long time for you to gain sufficient clearance.
And without a doubt, this will affect your life in Lungmen.
You've been in Lungmen for a long time, and I imagine you've already established a stable and fulfilling life. I don't want to get in the way of that.
Last time, I made a unilateral decision about your future, on my own whim. This time, you should make your own decision.
I hope that when you've carefully thought things through, you'll be able to give me your answer.
In the future, I'd like to make time to go see you in Lungmen. I'd like to have a nice chat with you.
Your sister who loves you dearly, Lemuen

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Your sister's a decent person.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course! She's the best!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ohhh, your big sis's comin' to Lungmen?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Boss?! When'd you get here?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: He's been standing there behind the counter bartending this entire time.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I popped in right the precise moment y'all walked into this bar.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: This ain't the wrong joint, is it?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No, it's the right one. Look, it's them!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What are you two doing here?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Baws called us on over.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: He dealt with that pesky manager, so I made my way over here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Boss, does that mean...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Damn right. We got a day worth celebrating, so I decided we throwin' a partaaaay!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What are we celebrating?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Exusiai's sis writin' her, what else?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Didn't you find out about that just now?!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aaaaand, we gotta welcome back long-term expat staff, Mostima!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That seems like a pretty good idea.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But, Mostima...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You called?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Woah! I thought you...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Just needed the washroom.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Your sister's my boss now. She told me to personally deliver that letter to you under pain of death.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ehh... You don't plan on quitting, do you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wanna guess if I've talked about it?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: There's no way she'd let you, haha!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aight, move your asses! Booze, ambience, tunes! Everything's on the Penguin Logistics house tonight!

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Staff
steps.text: Woohoo!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What can I get'cha?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Chocolate. Coffee.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Cake!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Pizza, and BBQ!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: This here's a bar, ladies! A bar!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Forget it. Askin' y'all's a waste of time. S'pose I'll look in back and see what got here. Just hafta make do.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, right, I can sing my brand-new song here tonight! You all hyped?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Is it the same song you asked me to hear that one time?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's right! Even Texas has never heard it before!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, that song's a bit too mushy and romantic. Not my slice of apple pie!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That means I'm doing something right! Your tastes are way too flashy. If you don't like my ballad, that means I've got the right feel down!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ehh? Why are you singing love songs at a party? We need something to get the blood pumping!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'll go check if that gang is out for any more trouble.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh... I'll go with you too, since it was my fault to begin with.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Nah, that's alright. I'll be right back.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, grab some booze on your way back. The piss they got here ain't fit for me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Anything you want me to do, since I'm technically still an employee of Penguin Logistics?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Uhh... Too bad, but nah!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: What if you had a talk with the old fella in your stick there and got us a li'l show, a song and dance act or somethin'.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That'd be kinda hard on me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mostima.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Do you know what the letter said?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Nope, but I can probably guess.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: In my position, I'm not exactly qualified to offer any advice, but––

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You have a good group of friends here. Don't you think, El?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I could use a hand 'er two back here. Anybody––

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Coming.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Look, sis. This is the kind of life we lead now.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Even though I should maybe blame you and Mostima for avoiding me, it's because of you two that I was able to make so many friends and find this wonderful life.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (I really love how things are going now.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (You're right about one thing.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (I've lived in Lungmen for a long time. My life has gradually shifted away from chasing the past, into spending every day with my partners here at Penguin Logistics.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (But really, that isn't quite true either.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (My experience has taught me that I want more than just a carefree life with the people around me.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (Texas has her past to deal with, Croissant dreams of being an entrepreneur, and Sora will also step onto a bigger stage one day.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (And they all know that I've never given up on chasing after you two.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (There's no such thing as an endless party. But I figure none of us are actually afraid of that.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (After all, being the best of friends doesn't mean that we're living lives indistinguishable from each other.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (What it means is that no matter where we go, we'll still look out for one another.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (So by the time you come to find me, you might be in for a big surprise.)

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: (After all, I'm sure I'll give you a very firm answer––)

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: What'cha spacin' out for, Exusiai?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Get over here and help me PUMP IT UP!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Coming!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Come one, come all. All the friends who've crossed our paths, all the unlucky fools who've crossed us. Let us all enjoy some––

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Apple pie!
